# Classifier corpus: one statement (one Query message) per record.
# Format: <flags><TAB><text>. Text that starts with a double quote is a Go quoted string.
# Flags: R:<reason> (rejected) or F (forwarded); fits (the text fits the safe shape: SafeRead,
# and Shareable outside a transaction unless rejected); was-co (the first build classified it
# coalescable; a record without was-co or new must never fit); new (added by the rework);
# hint (begins with the exact bytes /* mg:share */); bad (the lexer cannot tokenise it: Opaque);
# noexec (tier R does not run it; the reason is in NOTES.md). Flags not named are false.
# --- plain reads
F fits was-co	SELECT 1
F fits was-co	select 1
F fits was-co	SeLeCt 1

F was-co	SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM kv
F fits was-co	SELECT lower(v), upper(k) FROM kv
F fits was-co	SELECT coalesce(v, 'none') FROM kv WHERE k = 'a'
F fits was-co	SELECT * FROM kv
